name: P14 battle rules engine — text battle demo

steps.msg: spell submenu opens from the keyboard

steps.eval: (() => { for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) { const s = __DQ.state(); if (s.battle.phase !== 'command' || s.battle.enemies.some(e => e.telegraphing)) break; __DQ.autoplay(1, 'mash'); } return __DQ.state().battle; })()

steps.msg: boss winds up a Big Attack (or the fight ended first)

steps.eval: (() => { for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) { const s = __DQ.state(); if (s.battle.phase !== 'command' || s.battle.enemies.some(e => e.bigCooldown > 0)) break; __DQ.autoplay(1, 'mash'); } return __DQ.state().battle.enemies.map(e => [e.name, e.telegraphing, e.bigCooldown]); })()

(() => { for (let s = 1; s < 200; s++) { __DQ.instant(true); __DQ.battle('frittering_sands', {enemies: ['cactuddle'], seed: s}); __DQ.autoplay(99, 'smart'); const r = __DQ.state().snapshot.result; if (r && r.recruit && r.recruit.offer) { __DQ.instant(false); return s; } } __DQ.instant(false); return -1; })()

(() => { for (let s = 1; s < 300; s++) { __DQ.instant(true); __DQ.assist(0); __DQ.battle('long_lane_alone', {level: 1, enemies: ['toadstooligan', 'toadstooligan'], seed: s}); __DQ.autoplay(99, 'mash'); if (__DQ.state().battle.phase === 'defeat') { __DQ.instant(false); return s; } } __DQ.instant(false); return -1; })()

(() => { for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) { const s = __DQ.state(); if (s.battle.phase !== 'command' || s.battle.enemies[0].name === 'Mortmain Enfolded') break; __DQ.autoplay(1, 'smart'); } return __DQ.state().battle.enemies[0]; })()
